panels.description: COLORADO constructed wetland and downstream channel. Water is visibly clearer, but the inlet gate is nearly closed and the system looks finite. Leave upper-left clear.

A survey tray holds aquatic invertebrates beside a monitor showing a dated pilot survey and increased count without invented numerical values. A separate warning reads WETLAND FLOW CAPACITY: FINITE. Leave top-right clear.
A wall screen shows Croft beside his son's treatment schedule. The son appears only as a pale hand beneath hospital bedding behind a privacy partition. Leave upper-left clear.
Back in Nexus, Sitara and Roman watch the recording, divided by the archive case. Leave upper third clear.

items.text: CLARITY INDEX: PILOT IMPROVEMENT / FLOW CAPACITY LIMITED
DOWNSTREAM INVERTEBRATE SURVEY / WETLAND FLOW CAPACITY: FINITE

items.text: You want to stop the work that made this possible.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You knew it was useful. You knew it was controlled. Why is it wrong only now?
